structure_statistic.code:
def stat(d):
    x = np.asarray(d["habitat"], dtype=float)
    s, m, v = x.shape
    site_mean = x.mean(axis=1)
    grand = x.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    msb = m * ((site_mean - grand) ** 2).sum(axis=0) / (s - 1)
    msw = ((x - site_mean[:, None, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=(0, 1)) / (s * (m - 1))
    den = msb + (m - 1) * msw
    ok = den > 0
    if not np.any(ok):
        return 0.0
    icc = (msb - msw)[ok] / den[ok]
    return float(np.mean(icc))

notes: One-way ICC of the predictors across sites (not of the outcome). Differs from B2B-08 in the structure (hierarchy vs time), statistic (correlation) and data layout (3-d array).
